## HyperTile 0.3.0
The first public release.
- Tiles every window automatically, in Grid, Columns, Rows or Side layouts - Optional virtual desktops, with a four-finger swipe between them - Keyboard shortcuts to swap, focus, float and resize windows - Windows with a minimum or fixed size get room in the layout - Picks up trackpads connected after launch, and after sleep - Uses less energy when nothing on screen changes - Offers to move itself to Applications - Licence activation in the welcome tour and Settings → Licence
